package.description: It could not be easier to manage ZIPs than now with SomePythonThings Zip Manager! Create and extract ZIP files in one click!

en-US.description: It could not be easier to manage ZIPs than now with SomePythonThings Zip Manager! Create and extract ZIP files in one click!
en-US.longDescription:
SomePythonThings Zip manager is an application that lets you compress and extract files in a clever way.
Not as other compression applications, SomePythonThings Zip Manager has been developed to be useful.
SomePythonThings Zip Manager is an open-source application, and it's also 100% free.
en-US.name: SomePythonThings Zip Manager
